data.one_liner: Forwards dart:developer logging output to Android's logcat.
data.what_it_does: Extends the logging package with an activateLogcat() method. This sends all logs recorded via Logger directly to Android's logcat using native method channels, mapping custom severity levels appropriately.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter app for Android and use the logging package
You want to view your Dart logs inside Android Studio's Logcat
avoid_when: You are targeting non-Android platforms exclusively
You do not use the logging package
strengths: Seamless integration with the popular logging package
Maps standard logging levels to Android logcat levels cleanly
weaknesses: Not documented for platforms other than Android
